title: 第十八章 桃源藏秘境 伞影遇青娥第十九章 桃源生桃运 骄阳遇清欢
content_zh:
灵渊洞天清宁已定，魔氛尽涤，煞气全消。
两枚时序玉璧残片相继归位，融入何年神府本源。先天时序清气自四人身周缓缓漫溢，顺着地脉肌理、山川脉络、天地虚空，层层铺展、丝丝归序。此前崩裂的九州地脉、紊乱的山河时序、颠倒的四方阴阳，皆在双璧道韵滋养之下，悄然稳固、慢慢抚平、次第归真。
千里青嶂山脉，灵机重盛，草木重荣，泉流重活，峰峦重秀。
天庭众神归去之后，洞天之内再无杀伐戾气，唯余纯粹天道清气、灵渊本源生机，悠悠流转，氤氲绵长。
四人静坐玉台之上，调息养元，稳固此战所得道果。
经灵渊一战，先破魔帅大阵，再抗魔君暗袭，又得天庭神光疗愈、双璧本源加持，四人道心较之从前，更为澄澈通透、坚韧厚重。
何年神魂深处残存的魔刃阴毒尽数消融，时序大道底蕴再添浑厚，《六千字文》天篆道纹流转愈发圆融，年神本源解封大半，窥得更多天地时序秘理，枯荣轮转、岁月定序、天道兴衰之悟，尽纳于心。
何月月华道韵愈发温润慈悲，清辉可安万魂、可镇千煞、可柔万劫，心神愈发宁静稳固，再无初历浩劫时的孱弱彷徨，多了历经生死、渡尽苦难的从容定力。
花月初草木灵元生生不息，渊底渡化万千煞灵、滋养地脉生机，令其草木大道更添渡厄济世之能，一草一木皆藏仁心，一叶一花皆含道韵，生机可破寂灭，柔善可克阴邪。
何日骄阳神力愈发纯粹凛冽，正阳至刚、焚邪镇魔、守正护道，褪去年少莽撞，沉敛锋芒，进退有度，刚柔相济，日神道基愈发牢不可破。
四人心神相通，四道同源，经数次生死并肩、绝境相守、共破魔劫、同补天缺，羁绊早已入骨入道，远超寻常同道情谊，已是天道共生、祸福同存、兴衰与共。
半晌之后，四人调息完毕，齐齐睁眼。
四道神光澄澈透亮，映亮整座灵渊洞天，周遭玉光流转，清气袅袅，一派祥和天道盛景。
何年起身而立，眸光望向洞天之外绵延山河，神色沉稳淡然，缓缓开口：“双璧归位，天道补全二分，九州地脉大安，苍生灾厄锐减。然幽诡魔君遁走含恨，魔界杀机未歇，魔主蛰伏蓄势，灭世之心不死，我等补天之路，依旧道阻且长。”
“玉璧残片散落三界，或藏灵山灵渊，或隐绝境险地，或封太古秘境，或沉乱世尘寰。越是天道残缺最重、时序漏洞最深之地，越藏残璧真影，亦越藏未知凶险、隐秘机缘。”
何月素衣轻扬，缓步起身，月华柔光漫覆周身，轻声附和：“如今天地时序渐稳，正道气运升腾，魔邪敛迹蛰伏，正是我等遍历山河、寻访残璧的最佳时机。前路不必急于杀伐，可徐徐踏遍四海八荒，观山河复苏，察天地气机，寻天道破绽，觅玉璧残踪。”
花月初指尖凝翠，一缕生机灵息萦绕指尖，浅笑嫣然：“浩劫之后，必有新生。乱世终末，必藏秘境。天地为自救补全，常会在浊世之中，开辟一方净土桃源，藏先天灵机、隐上古道韵、存天道余泽，其内往往藏有时序秘辛、残璧气机、济世机缘。”
何日昂首挺胸，骄阳金辉内敛沉稳，朗声道：“管它秘境险地、古渊绝域，我四人同心一体，有道心护体、天道加持、天庭为援，纵使前路千般迷雾、万重危机，亦可从容踏过、一一勘破！”
四人心意合一，再无迟疑。
整理周身神泽，收束大道灵气，辞别灵渊洞天，循着山川清气流转之向，凌空踏出地底深渊，重返青嶂千山之巅。

登临山巅，放眼万里山河，天地景象焕然一新。
此前压抑昏暗、魔氛笼罩的苍穹，此刻万里澄澈，云絮舒卷，清风朗朗，天光温柔。大地上，崩裂山峦愈合，枯竭溪流重涌，焦黑土地生绿，荒芜田野复苏，四方灾气消散，人间烟火渐生。
双璧归位之泽，润物无声，普惠苍生。
四人立于云巅，俯瞰盛世初萌的山河，心中皆是浩然宽慰。
历尽万劫千难，浴血杀伐抗争，所求不过山河安定、时序井然、苍生安宁、天地清平。
何年抬手，时序神光铺展千里，勘遍四方气机，眸光微微一动：“东南百里之外，山川气机隔绝尘寰，灵气纯粹至极，无魔浊、无煞戾、无灾厄、无乱象，与乱世山河格格不入，似是一方独立世外洞天。”
“此地气运清幽祥和、道韵古朴绵长、生机无穷无尽，绝非寻常山野灵地，必是天地浩劫之中，自行闭锁、独存清净的上古秘境。”
何月眸光望向东南，月华清辉穿透层云，轻声道：“此方秘境时序自成一体，四时不凋，寒暑不侵，阴阳自稳，轮回自洽，好似乱世中的一方净土，与世无争，独守清宁。”
花月初颔首道：“草木道韵极盛，生机绵亘万古，藏有先天草木大道本源，必是上古遗留的桃花源秘境。传说此界生于洪荒之初，存于天道缝隙，每逢天地浩劫、三界崩坏之时，便会自行隐匿闭锁，收纳流离生灵、残存道韵、天地生机，静待乱世终结、天道重圆。”
何日眼中闪过兴致，朗声笑道：“原来便是传说中的世外桃源！乱世独清，浩劫独安，必藏天道机缘，说不定便藏有第三枚时序残璧气机！我等即刻前往一探究竟！”
四人相视一笑，不再迟疑，身形一动，化作四道流光，划破万里层云，朝着东南百里之外的桃花源秘境疾驰而去。
一路乘风踏云，山河渐秀，尘嚣渐远，乱世浊气层层褪去。
越靠近秘境地界，周遭灵气愈发纯粹温润，风声轻柔，云气恬淡，鸟语花香渐生，天地之间，再无半分浩劫肃杀之气。
不过半刻，四人已然行至秘境边界。
眼前景象，骤然惊艳尘寰。
前方一道连绵青山横亘大地，山外是历经浩劫、百废待兴的乱世山河，山内却是四季如春、繁花不败、草木常青、流水潺潺的绝美桃源。
一山隔两世，一界分浊清。
山口之外，残痕犹存、灾厄未消、风尘未净；山口之内，洞天澄澈、岁月安然、盛世长存、万古清幽。
山口立着一座古朴石坊，石纹苍古，字迹流云，上书，四个篆字，历经万古风霜，依旧温润光亮，隐有天道道韵流转。石坊两侧古木参天，桃花成林，落英纷飞，粉白花瓣随风漫舞，铺满青石古道，芬芳漫溢四野。
溪流绕林，清泉漱石，良田错落，竹舍清幽，烟霞袅袅，鹤鸟翩飞，一派上古田园盛世，不染半点乱世尘埃。

四人驻足石坊之前，望着眼前与世隔绝的绝美秘境，心中皆生安然恬淡之意。
久经杀伐血劫、屡历生死绝境、日日面对魔浊煞戾、夜夜身临灭世危机，骤然踏入这般温柔安然、清净无争的桃源天地，紧绷多日的心弦，骤然松弛下来，心神澄澈安宁，道心愈发温润通透。
content_en:
The sky in Lingyuan Cave is clear and peaceful, the evil atmosphere has been purged, and the evil spirits have completely disappeared.
The two jade fragments from the time series returned to their places one after another and merged into the origin of He Nian Shenfu. The innate time-ordered Qi slowly overflows from around the four people, spreading out layer by layer and arranged in order along the texture of the earth's veins, the veins of mountains and rivers, and the void of heaven and earth. The previously ruptured Kyushu earth veins, the disordered sequence of mountains and rivers, and the reversed yin and yang in all directions were all quietly stabilized, slowly healed, and returned to their true state one after another under the nourishment of the double jade Taoist rhyme.
Thousands of miles of Qingzhang Mountains are full of inspiration, lush vegetation, vibrant springs, and beautiful peaks.
After the gods in heaven returned, there was no more murderous and violent energy in the cave. Only the pure pure air of heaven and the original vitality of the spiritual abyss were left, flowing slowly and lingering.
The four of them sat quietly on the jade platform, regulating their breath and nourishing their energy, and stabilized the Taoist fruits gained from this battle.
After a battle in Lingyuan, they first defeated the Demon Lord's formation, and then resisted the Demon Lord's secret attack. They were healed by the divine light from heaven and blessed by the twin stones. The Taoist hearts of the four people became clearer, more tenacious and thicker than before.
The evil spirit of the demon blade that remained in the depths of He Nian's soul has been completely dissolved, and the foundation of the Great Path of Time has become more profound. The pattern of the seal script in the "Six Thousand Characters" has become more and more smooth. The origin of the Nian God has been mostly unsealed, and more secrets of the time sequence of heaven and earth have been glimpsed. The understanding of the rotation of prosperity and decline, the order of time, and the rise and fall of the way of heaven has been fully absorbed in the heart.
He Yue Yuehua's Taoist rhyme becomes more gentle and compassionate, and its clear brilliance can calm thousands of souls, suppress thousands of evil spirits, and soften thousands of calamities. The mind becomes more peaceful and stable. There is no longer the weakness and hesitation when experiencing the catastrophe for the first time, but more calmness and concentration after life and death, and overcoming all suffering.
At the beginning of the month of flowering, the spiritual energy of vegetation is endless, transforming thousands of evil spirits from the bottom of the abyss, nourishing the vitality of the earth's veins, making the avenues of vegetation more capable of surviving adversity and helping the world. Every plant and tree has a heart of benevolence, every leaf and every flower contains the charm of the Tao, vitality can break the silence, and gentleness can overcome the evil spirits.
On that day, the divine power of the blazing sun becomes more pure and fierce. The righteous yang is extremely strong, burns evil and suppresses demons, and protects the righteous path. It fades away from the recklessness of youth, calms down the edge, advances and retreats in a controlled manner, and balances hardness and softness. The foundation of the sun god's path becomes more and more unbreakable.
The four minds are interconnected and the four paths have the same origin. They have lived side by side for many times in life and death, stayed together in desperate situations, fought against evil calamities together, and repaired the gaps in the sky together. The bond has long been entrenched in the bones and entered the Tao. It is far beyond the ordinary friendship of the same Tao.
After a while, the four of them finished adjusting their breaths and all opened their eyes.
The four rays of divine light are clear and bright, illuminating the entire Lingyuan Cave. The surrounding jade light is flowing, and the clear air is curling up, creating a peaceful and grand scene of heaven.
He Nian stood up and looked at the mountains and rivers outside the cave. His expression was calm and indifferent, and he spoke slowly: "The two jade stones have returned to their places, the heavenly path has been completed, the nine states are safe, and the disasters of the people have been reduced sharply. However, the ghostly demon king has escaped with hatred, the murderous intention of the demon world has not stopped, the demon lord is dormant and gathering momentum, and the desire to destroy the world is not dead. Our road to mending the sky is still long and difficult."
"The jade fragments are scattered in the three realms, hiding in spiritual mountains and spiritual abyss, hiding in desperate and dangerous places, sealing ancient secret realms, or causing chaos in the world. The more incomplete the heavenly path is and the deepest time loopholes, the more the true shadow of the jade is hidden, and the more unknown dangers and hidden opportunities are hidden."
He Yue's plain clothes fluttered lightly, and she stood up slowly. The soft light of the moonlight covered her whole body, and she echoed softly: "Now that the time of heaven and earth is gradually stabilizing, the righteous destiny is rising, and the evil spirits are gathering and dormant, it is the best time for us to travel through the mountains and rivers to search for the remaining jade. There is no need to rush to kill people on the way forward, but we can slowly travel across the four seas and wastelands to watch the mountains and rivers recover, observe the qi of heaven and earth, look for flaws in the way of heaven, and look for the remaining traces of the jade."
At the beginning of the flower, the fingertips are green, and a wisp of vitality lingers around the fingertips. She smiles sweetly: "After the catastrophe, there must be new life. At the end of the troubled times, there must be a secret realm. The heaven and the earth are trying to save themselves and complete themselves. They often open up a pure land in the troubled times to hide the innate wisdom, conceal the charm of the ancient Tao, and preserve the remnants of the heavenly way. There are often secrets of timing, remnants of energy, and opportunities to help the world."
Heri held his head high and held his chest high, the scorching golden light was restrained and steady, and he said loudly: "No matter it is a secret place, a dangerous place, or an ancient abyss, the four of us are of one mind, with a Taoist heart to protect our bodies, a heavenly way to bless us, and a heavenly court to support us. Even if the road ahead is filled with mist and numerous crises,, you can also step through it calmly and explore them one by one! "
The four of them were united and there was no hesitation.
Sort out the spirit of the whole body, gather the spiritual energy of the great road, say goodbye to the spiritual abyss and the cave, follow the direction of the clear air of the mountains and rivers, step out of the underground abyss, and return to the top of Qingzhang Qianshan.
Climbing to the top of the mountain and looking across thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, the scene of heaven and earth is completely new.
The sky, which was previously oppressive, dark, and shrouded in a demonic atmosphere, is now clear and clear, the clouds are rolling, the breeze is clear, and the sky is gentle. On the earth, the cracked mountains healed, dried up streams surged again, the scorched black land became green, the desolate fields revived, the disasters in all directions dissipated, and the world gradually grew fireworks.
The beauty of the return of the two jade stones can moisturize things silently and benefit the common people.
The four of them stood on the top of the clouds, overlooking the budding mountains and rivers of the prosperous age, and felt great relief in their hearts.
After going through thousands of calamities and hardships, and fighting bloody battles, all they want is peace in the mountains and rivers, order in time, peace in the people, and peace in the world.
He Nian raised his hand, and the divine light of time spread out for thousands of miles, surveying the energy in all directions, and his eyes moved slightly: "A hundred miles away in the southeast, the mountains and rivers are isolated from the world. The spiritual energy is extremely pure. There is no demonic turbidity, no evil, no disaster, no chaos. It is incompatible with the mountains and rivers in the troubled times. It seems to be an independent cave in the world. "
“This place’s luck is quiet and peaceful, its Taoist charm is simple and long-lasting, and its vitality is endless. It is definitely not an ordinary mountain and wild spiritual place. It must be an ancient secret place that has closed itself and survived alone in the catastrophe of heaven and earth. "
He Yue looked to the southeast, and the clear moonlight penetrated the clouds, and said softly: "The time sequence of this secret realm is self-contained, never withered by the four seasons, not invaded by cold or heat, yin and yang are self-stable, and reincarnation is self-consistent. It is like a pure land in a troubled world. It has no competition with the world and only maintains tranquility. "
Hua Yue nodded and said: "The charm of the Tao of grass and trees is extremely prosperous, and its vitality lasts forever. It contains the origin of the innate Tao of grass and trees. It must be the secret land of Peach Blossom Land left over from ancient times. Legend has it that this world was born in the beginning of the prehistoric period and existed in the gap between heaven and earth. Whenever there was a catastrophe between heaven and earth and the collapse of the three realms, it would hide and close itself, absorbing the wandering creatures, the remaining Taoist charm, and the vitality of heaven and earth, waiting for the end of the troubled times and the reunion of heaven and earth. "
Interest flashed in Heri's eyes and he laughed loudly: "It turns out to be the legendary paradise! In troubled times, there is only peace, and there is only peace in the catastrophe. There must be a chance of heaven, and maybe there is a third time sequence remnant! I'll go and find out immediately! "
The four people looked at each other and smiled, no longer hesitating. With a movement of their bodies, they turned into four streams of light, cutting through the clouds for thousands of miles, and speeding towards the secret land of Peach Blossom Spring, a hundred miles to the southeast.
Riding on the wind and riding on the clouds, the mountains and rivers become more and more beautiful, the hustle and bustle of the city gradually fades away, and the turbulent atmosphere of the troubled times fades away layer by layer.
The closer you get to the secret realm, the spiritual energy around you becomes purer and warmer, the wind blows softly, the clouds are calm, the birds sing and the fragrance of flowers gradually grows, and there is no more aura of catastrophe and murder between heaven and earth.
In just half a moment, the four of them had already reached the edge of the secret realm.
The scene in front of me was suddenly stunning.
In front of you is a continuous green mountain stretching across the land. Outside the mountain are the mountains and rivers of the troubled times that have gone through catastrophes and are in need of restoration. But inside the mountain is a beautiful peach land with spring-like weather all year round, unbroken flowers, evergreen vegetation and gurgling water.
A mountain separates two lives, and a world separates turbidity and purity.
Outside the mountain pass, traces still remain, disasters have not disappeared, and the dust has not been cleared away; inside the mountain pass, the cave sky is clear, the years are peaceful, the prosperity lasts forever, and the tranquility is eternal.
There is a simple stone square standing at the mountain pass. The stone pattern is ancient, and the handwriting is flowing clouds. The letter, four seal characters, has gone through eternity, but it is still warm and bright, and there is a hidden charm of the way of heaven. On both sides of the stone square, there are towering ancient trees, a forest of peach blossoms, flying fallen flowers, pink and white petals dancing in the wind, paving the ancient bluestone road, and the fragrance filling the fields.
Streams wind around the forest, clear springs wash the rocks, fertile fields are scattered here and there, bamboo houses are quiet, mist curls up, and cranes and birds fly. It is like an ancient pastoral flourishing time, unstained by the dust of the troubled world.
The four of them stopped in front of the stone square and looked at the beautiful secret land in front of them, feeling peaceful and tranquil in their hearts.
After many bloody tribulations, many desperate situations of life and death, facing demons and cruelty every day, and facing the crisis of annihilation every night, he suddenly stepped into such a gentle, peaceful, pure and uncontested paradise world., the heartstrings that had been tense for many days suddenly relaxed, my mind became clear and peaceful, and my Taoist heart became warmer and more transparent.
